title: Dedicated Capacity Quickstart: visual assets for capacity setup, autoscaling preview, and SLA summary
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a cohesive set of onboarding visuals for the Dedicated offering that walk new customers through capacity setup, autoscaling configuration, and the SLA overview card. Outputs include a step-by-step capacity wizard mockups, an interactive autoscale preview panel (static screenshots for docs), an SLA summary card with guaranteed metrics and fallback behavior, and 1–2 annotated screenshots for the public quickstart guide.
acceptance_criteria: Three high-fidelity mockups: capacity-wizard, autoscale-preview, sla-summary-card
Annotated screenshots (2) for docs with callouts to key controls and default values
Figma file shared with engineering and PM + link in ticket
Design tokens and spacing guidelines exported in the shared figma page
Accessibility notes added (contrast ratios, keyboard flow for wizard steps)
Sign-off from PM (Aisha Patel) and Eng lead (Ravi Mehta) recorded in comments
tasks: Draft low-fi wireframes for capacity wizard (stepper with defaults)
Design autoscale preview mockup: slider + projected throughput/cost chart
Design SLA summary card with percent SLOs and fallback model indicator
Create annotated screenshots for docs team explaining defaults and decision points
Export image assets in 2x and 3x for retina and mobile
Handoff meeting with engineering to confirm feasibility for console implementation
Incorporate accessibility checklist and keyboard navigation notes
progress_updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff with PM and Eng. Agreed scope and deliverables. Noted constraint: console uses existing tokens and color palette.
2026-03-05: Low-fi wireframes completed and iterated with PM. Removed an optional advanced section to reduce cognitive load.
2026-03-08: High-fi mocks for capacity wizard v1 completed. Uploaded to Figma and added annotations for default commit units and burst capacity behavior.
2026-03-10: Autoscale preview initial chart added. Eng requested explicit smoothing algorithm tooltip; added note for follow-up.
2026-03-12: SLA card variants (compact and expanded) uploaded. PM requested a clear fallback flow visual; added small routing diagram under the SLA card. Assigned review to Aisha and Ravi.
decisions: Keep default autoscale policy conservative: 2x baseline, burst up to 4x
Show cost estimate band rather than single-point estimate to communicate variance
SLA card will display three aggregates: uptime %, P99 latency target, and time-to-failover
Fallback routing diagram will use simplified three-node illustration (primary region, fallback model, user app)
